limits: One110s diagnostic, not validation. Counts are overlapping observations, not independent opportunities. Exact same-tick HUD synchronization, still no ground-truth NPC IDs or guarantee all toasts observed.
render_caveat: Game update runs each requestAnimationFrame but draw runs every second frame. Same-tick HUD and decision eliminates external read offset, but canvas may still depict previous game frame. Do not treat an NPC visible on capture tick as a second failed opportunity.
next_step: Use synchronized observations and exclude capture-tick stale canvas/confirmed outline fragments before auditing no-growth episodes. Keep instrumentation for future experiments, no policy patch yet.
